clue.text: Stroke or a comma, maybe

definitions.meaning: a swimming style in which both arms sweep over together
the comma is a species of orange-brown winged insect with a white comma-shaped mark

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the swimming stroke; the other is the insect family to which the comma species belongs, so the comma is an example.

clue.text: Foodstuff successfully brought home

definitions.meaning: from the idiom about bringing home the cured pork, meaning to succeed or earn a living

explanation.definitionFit: It is cured pig meat, and also what a breadwinner proverbially brings home when succeeding.

clue.text: For example, Othello's attempt to trap Ancient

indicators.note: one word closes around the other, as a trap encloses its catch

parts.note: an attempt is a try
ancient means very old, aged

explanation.surface: Othello attempts to ensnare his ancient, Iago, his standard-bearer.
explanation.walkthrough: In the surface 'Ancient' is Iago's military rank in the play; here it simply means old.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Othello is a classic example of the dramatic genre ending in the hero's downfall.

clue.text: Appealed to doctor in dire need

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other
dire suggests something in a terrible state, so the letters of need are wrecked

parts.note: to doctor a patient is to treat them

explanation.surface: Someone in desperate need made an appeal to a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' looks like the person appealed to, but it is the verb meaning to treat; 'dire' scrambles the word after it into ENED.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean begged or made an earnest request of someone.

clue.text: A digital recording?

parts.note: digital is read as relating to fingers rather than computers: a picture recorded with the digits

explanation.definitionFit: Children's artwork made by dabbing colour with the fingertips, a record made by the digits.

clue.text: Plant eaten by many Americans

indicators.note: the plant is swallowed up by the two words, lying inside them across the gap

explanation.surface: A vegetable that lots of people in the USA consume.
explanation.definitionFit: A tropical climbing vine grown for its starchy tuber.

clue.text: Source of oils for painter following Constable, perhaps

indicators.note: the painter comes after the policeman in the answer

parts.note: a police constable is an example of a cop
RA is a Royal Academician, a painter elected to the Royal Academy

explanation.surface: Seeking a source of oil paints for an artist who comes after John Constable.
explanation.walkthrough: Constable looks like the English landscape painter, which suits 'painter' and 'oils', but it is a policeman.
explanation.definitionFit: Dried coconut kernel, pressed to yield coconut oil.

clue.text: Pass round article read initially to provide notes

indicators.note: the mountain pass goes round the other letters

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
a is the indefinite article

indicators.note: only the opening letter of read is used

explanation.surface: Passing a piece round for someone to read, then supplying notes on it.
explanation.walkthrough: COL is a crossword favourite for a pass between peaks.
explanation.definitionFit: To sing joyfully is to make musical sounds, especially festive songs.

clue.text: Table helping served on gold

indicators.note: in a down answer, one piece sits on top of the other

parts.note: a helping served is a plateful, a plate of food
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A table where food is dished up on golden platters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Table' is not furniture: it is a tableland, a flat-topped stretch of high ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A tableland is an elevated region with a level top.

clue.text: Centaurs in centrally-heated accommodation

indicators.note: the centaurs go inside the other letters
only the central pair of letters of heated is taken

parts.note: centaurs are half horse, so only part men

explanation.surface: Mythical horse-men living in a home with central heating.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle of HEATED is AT, and PART MEN goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat, a set of rooms to live in, is a form of lodging.

clue.text: About to join expedition north? That's correct

parts.note: c is short for circa, Latin for about
expedition here means speed, haste

explanation.surface: Someone wants to join a polar trek northwards and asks if that is right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expedition' reads as a journey but is its older sense of promptness.
explanation.definitionFit: To discipline or rebuke someone is to put them right.

clue.text: Wine stain, sad to say, returns

parts.note: to mar is to blemish or stain

indicators.note: the exclamation comes back, read from right to left

parts.note: alas is the word one says when something is sad

explanation.surface: A wine stain keeps coming back, regrettably.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortified wine from Sicily.

clue.text: Relative beginners in navigation inducing extensive compass errors

indicators.note: the first letters of each of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: Novice sailors find their navigation causes large compass mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: A brother's or sister's daughter is a family member.

clue.text: Capital better advanced

parts.note: to better is to surpass, excel
to advance money is to lend it

explanation.surface: A capital city improved and moved forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' is the old British exclamation of approval, not a city or money.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital as an old-fashioned British exclamation means first-rate.

clue.text: Byzantine consented to retaining disastrous Act

indicators.note: the agreeing word holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: complied means went along with, consented to

indicators.note: a disastrous thing is wrecked, so the letters of act are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Byzantine ruler agreed to keep a ruinous law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Byzantine' looks like a reference to the old empire, but here it means intricate; 'disastrous' scrambles the law's letters into CAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Byzantine with a small b means intricate and convoluted, as Byzantine bureaucracy was.

clue.text: Retiring cast?

definitions.meaning: to cast is to throw or fling, as at a coconut stall

explanation.definitionFit: It means timid and reserved, and also to toss or hurl something.

clue.text: Extent of usefulness on board

parts.note: the board is a plank of storage on which goods sit before expiring

explanation.definitionFit: The time a product can stay on sale before it spoils is its useful span sitting on a storage plank.

clue.text: Indicator of distance, but not as rigid rule

definitions.text: Indicator of distance, but not as rigid rule

parts.words: Indicator of distance, but not as rigid rule
parts.note: a measuring device like a ruler, but flexible, rolled up as a strip of cloth or metal

explanation.definitionFit: A flexible strip marked in units is used to gauge lengths, unlike a stiff ruler.

clue.text: Able to imbibe in bar on best cocktail

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters are shaken up

explanation.surface: Someone who can drink a lot at the bar orders the best mixed drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that soaks up liquid is like a drinker taking it in.

clue.text: Eastern runner in dark suit and light shoes

indicators.note: the stream goes inside the card suit

parts.note: spades is a black suit in cards
a rill is a small stream, something that runs

explanation.surface: An oriental athlete in a dark suit wearing lightweight footwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dark suit' is clothing in the surface but a black suit of playing cards; 'runner' is water, not an athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: Rope-soled canvas sandals are light summer footwear.

clue.text: Duck or grouse — it needs plain cooking

indicators.note: cooking suggests preparing or fiddling with something, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Game birds such as duck or grouse need simple preparation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grouse' is a bird here, the sharp-tailed grouse also named for its pointed tail, not a complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-tailed dabbling waterfowl bears the name, and so does a North American game bird.

clue.text: Took turn by junction

parts.note: a go is a turn in a game
a T is a junction shaped like the letter

explanation.surface: Someone took a turn at a road junction.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are past tenses meaning obtained or received.

clue.text: Pygmalion made her a celebration meal

parts.note: a gala is a festive occasion
tea is an afternoon or evening meal

explanation.surface: Pygmalion threw her a party with food.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth the sculptor Pygmalion carved a woman who came to life; later tellings name her this.
explanation.definitionFit: The ivory statue the sculptor fashioned and fell in love with bears this name.

clue.text: Worker in firm put in charge expresses amazement

definitions.note: the definition is a verb phrase, the answer an exclamation that does the expressing

indicators.note: the insect is placed inside the word for firm

parts.note: fast means firm, fixed
a worker ant is the crossword worker

explanation.surface: An employee promoted to manager is astonished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'firm' looks like a company but means secure.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is an exclamation of wonder, used to voice astonishment.

clue.text: Army rising securing intelligence from emissary

indicators.note: the army holds the information inside it
in a down answer the letters go upwards, read in reverse

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: A rebel army gets secret information out of an envoy.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'rising' reverses the army's letters into AT; 'from' is only a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A representative sent to act on someone's behalf, an envoy.

clue.text: Lists and turns over

definitions.meaning: tumbles over and over, as a ball does

explanation.definitionFit: Registers of names, and also revolves or tumbles.

clue.text: Second kiss of little substance

parts.note: a peck is a quick kiss

explanation.surface: A second kiss turned out to be a trivial affair.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny particle or spot is a minute bit of matter.

clue.text: Why, say, boy with French friend sent back pictures

indicators.note: the whole string of pieces is read in reverse
say means the word is spoken, giving the letter that sounds the same

parts.note: the question word sounds like the letter
Reg is a boy's name
ami is French for friend

explanation.surface: A lad and his French pal are sent home with some photos.
explanation.walkthrough: Y, REG and AMI are all reversed by 'sent back', giving IMA GER Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Vivid descriptive language or visual images in general.

clue.text: Approval given to son supporting the old

indicators.note: in a down answer, the son sits below and holds up the other piece

parts.note: ye is the old form of the, as in Ye Olde Shoppe

explanation.surface: A son supports his elderly parents and gets their blessing.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a signal of agreement or assent.

clue.text: Letters distributed in support of Board

indicators.note: the letters are spread around into a new order

explanation.surface: Letters are handed out backing the Board of directors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Board' reads as a committee but is a plank or table top.
explanation.definitionFit: A trestle is a frame holding up a tabletop or plank.

clue.text: Note about magnesium silicate's effect

parts.note: E is a musical note

indicators.note: the mineral turns round, read backwards

parts.note: talc is magnesium silicate

explanation.surface: A remark on the effect of a magnesium mineral.
explanation.definitionFit: Brilliant success or striking impact, from the French for a burst.

clue.text: Postpone consideration of the sign of the Crab?

definitions.meaning: to divert or shelve a matter
a crab walks sideways, so its trail runs sideways; the Crab is also the zodiac sign Cancer

explanation.definitionFit: To divert from the main issue, and humorously the trail left by a crustacean that moves sideways.
